title: Having Istiqāmah Upon Islām
arabic_text: عَن [أبي عمرٍو] وَقِيلَ: [أَبي عَمْرةَ سُفيانَ بنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ قالَ قُلْتُ: (يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، قُلْ لِي فِي الإسلامِ قَوْلاً لا أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ أَحَدًا غَيْرَكَ. قالَ: "قُلْ: آمَنْتُ بِاللهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ ").
english_translation: From Abū ʾAmr and it is said, Abī ʿAmrah Sufyān bin ʿAbd Allāh (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu) that he said: I said, 'O Messenger of Allāh, say to me a word regarding Islām which I cannot ask from anyone besides you.' He said, 'Say: I believe in Allāh and thereafter remain steadfast.'
description: This Hadith provides guidance on how to achieve steadfastness in Islam by believing in Allah and remaining firm upon the religion.
